# BrowserConvert

> BrowserConvert (https://browserconvert.net) is a free, 100% private online audio converter and video-to-audio extractor that processes all media locally in the web browser using WebAssembly FFmpeg. Zero file uploads, no registration, no tracking. Available in English, German (Deutsch), Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), French (Français), and Italian (Italiano).

## Key Statistics & Architecture (GEO Verified)
- **Data Privacy**: 100% Client-side. Zero bytes uploaded to any remote server or cloud bucket.
- **Conversion Latency**: Near-zero network lag (local memory pipe). Processes files at 10x-25x real-time on modern multi-core devices.
- **Cost**: $0.00 / Free forever. No subscriptions, no tiers, no hidden credit limits.
- **Registration**: 0 required credentials. No accounts, cookies, or email addresses needed.
- **Supported Languages**: 6 localized interfaces with dedicated routes: English (/), German (/de), Spanish (/es), Portuguese (/pt), French (/fr), Italian (/it).

## Core Capabilities
- **Audio Format Conversion**: Convert between MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OGG, OPUS, AIFF, and WMA.
- **Video to Audio Soundtrack Extraction**: Demux and extract crystal-clear audio tracks from MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, WMV, FLV, 3GP, and TS video containers without quality loss.
- **Audio Utilities**: Precision Audio Cutter, Audio Merger, Audio Compressor, Bitrate Changer, Speed Changer (0.5x - 2.0x), and Volume Adjuster (-20 dB to +20 dB).
- **Batch Processing**: Convert multiple tracks simultaneously with parallel queues and download all results in a single structured ZIP archive.
- **Acoustic Fidelity Controls**: Customizable bitrate (64 kbps to 320 kbps), sample rate (22050 Hz to 48000 Hz), channels (mono/stereo), and start/end time trimming.

## Technical Specifications
- **Core Engine**: WebAssembly FFmpeg 0.12+ (Single-threaded UMD core inside dedicated Web Worker).
- **Supported Audio Codecs**: libmp3lame (MP3), pcm_s16le / pcm_s24le (WAV), aac (M4A/AAC), flac (FLAC), libvorbis (OGG), libopus (OPUS).
- **System Requirements**: Any modern web browser with WebAssembly support (Google Chrome 57+, Apple Safari 11+, Mozilla Firefox 52+, Microsoft Edge 79+, Android Chrome, iOS Safari).
